title: MathTask input v1
description: Domain input payload for the Math adapter's normalize_task. Carries the M0 freeze (statement, object domain, quantifiers), assumptions/dependencies, the sought outcome class, and the core research-task material. All timestamps are caller-injected; the adapter reads no clock.

task_id.description: Caller-allocated id for the mapped core research-task/v1 record.

object_domain.description: M0: frozen object domain (for example integers, finite graphs on <= 12 vertices).

quantifiers.description: M0: frozen quantifier order and scope (for example: forall even n in (2, 10000]).

assumptions.description: Frozen assumptions. Required; write an explicit empty array when none.

dependencies.description: Frozen external dependencies (lemmas, libraries, prior results). Required; explicit empty array when none.

sought.description: Sought outcome class. bounded_verification caps any derived evaluation contract at engineering_verified.

scope.description: Passed through to the core task draft's scope.

resources.description: Passed through to the core task draft's resources envelope.

created_at.description: Caller-injected freeze timestamp; the adapter never reads a clock.
